body.x: Smart technologies that help the convenienceof life are developing exponentially. Cloud computing and platformtechnologies, big data and analysis, mobile solutions, Internet of Things (IoT)technology, and voice and artificial intelligence (AI) accelerate home digitalinnovation and have a major impact on new product production.
Three trends of smart home are as follows. △ Simplicity △ Comfort and security △ Energy management system
(Video description: CES 2018, 'Accessibility Technology Zone' which introduces various smart devices)

First, simplification. In the production ofproducts intended for consumers, producers should place an emphasis on theconsumer experience. Various companies are focusing on making new userinterface (UI) technology ubiquitous. In that situation, the complex UI shouldbe minimized. Simpler buttons than complex structures can attract consumers.Artificial intelligence (AI) and voice aids are essential to simplify the UI.Although not yet generalized, it is expected that approximately 220 millionvoice control smart home devices will be used by 2021.

Not only voice devices, but also touch panels, home displays, etc., can be a device that makes the user interface more useful. It is easy to interact with family and friends through the smart home system. Of course, such a system would have to be provided at a reasonable price.

The combination of voice and display enablesusers' immersive experience. As the device collects data, learns its behavior,and detects patterns, an autonomous environment is created that can ultimatelypredict the needs of the user.

Second, comfort and security. Sales of smart home products are on the rise due to increased convenience and improved quality of life. "Comfort" is a fundamental reason consumers buy smart home devices. For example, using a security camera allows you to monitor your baby at a distance, even when you are not at home, so you can have comfort and safety. Third, smart energy management system. Intelligent energy management makes it easy to control the heat in your home. In addition, it can create its own energy supply.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the largest IT exhibitionin the world, is an exhibition that can grasp the flow of the home electronicsindustry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer TechnologyAssociation (CTA) and is held every January. A global news network that mostrecently reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three techexhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CESthis year to report major issues in the world market, I introduce to the world.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
